targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', received_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Events" FROM syslog_events WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM syslog_events WHERE threat_type IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM syslog_events WHERE action IN ('blocked','drop') AND $__timeFilter(received_at);
SELECT hostname AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM syslog_events WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND hostname IS NOT NULL GROUP BY hostname ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT date_trunc('hour', received_at) AS time, severity::text AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM syslog_events WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND severity IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT app_name AS "App", COUNT(*) AS "Events" FROM syslog_events WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND app_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY app_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15;
SELECT threat_type AS "Type", COUNT(*) AS "Count" FROM syslog_events WHERE threat_type IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;
SELECT date_trunc('hour', received_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "SSH Events" FROM syslog_events WHERE app_name = 'sshd' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT date_trunc('hour', received_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Crash Storms" FROM syslog_events WHERE threat_type = 'crash_storm' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT date_trunc('hour', received_at) AS time, hostname AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM syslog_events WHERE app_name = 'sudo' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;
